manifest.summary: The greeting accepts a name and an observer exercises the personalized result.

items.title: Personalize the greeting
items.before: The greeting took no argument and returned a fixed value.
items.after: The greeting accepts a defaulted name and includes it in the result.
items.statement: Greeting construction now interpolates its input.

items.title: Observe a named greeting
items.statement: A test invokes the greeting with a name and compares the result.
